headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 reaches 78.51% matched code and gains port-only C
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 rises from 61.22% to 78.51% matched code, with 4,215 of 5,109 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. #46 adds 508 functions through completed near misses and adaptations from the US decompilation. Separate functional C supports the native port's gameplay, camera, menus and effects without receiving matching credit (#47).
highlights: A shared game-object structure replaces private views across level files (#46).
Behaviour-comparison tools distinguish usable non-matching reconstructions from exact matches and refuse checks that compare no captured calls.
Port-only work covers Ratchet's movement, hand attachments, crate setup, menu handlers and flight trails. These bodies do not increase the match percentage (#47).
